# Alpha Engineer / MindDividend Shield

> A multilingual, safety-first first check for suspicious messages and practical guides for common online scams.

MindDividend Shield helps people pause before clicking, paying, replying, sharing a code, or giving remote access. It is a first-pass signal, not a guarantee and not a replacement for a bank, platform, law-enforcement agency, or qualified professional.

## Primary resources

- [Start here](https://alphaengineerai.com/start.html): multilingual entry point, safety rule, and public sharing links.
- [Is this text a scam?](https://alphaengineerai.com/is-this-text-a-scam.html): high-intent guide to urgency, codes, payment requests, impersonation, unsafe links, and safer next steps.
- [Global online scam message checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/global-online-scam-checker.html): focused entry point with safe-use rules, common signals, FAQs, and ten-language links.
- [Scam message checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/scam-message-checker.html): English guide for suspicious texts, email, DMs, bank alerts, jobs, and payments.
- [WhatsApp scam message checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/whatsapp-scam-message-checker.html): checks verification-code requests, family emergencies, fake support, groups, and payment links.
- [Phishing email checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/phishing-email-checker.html): checks sender identity, login links, attachments, invoices, payment requests, and urgency.
- [Common online scams](https://alphaengineerai.com/common-online-scams.html): English overview of bank, delivery, job, investment, marketplace, impersonation, and tech-support scams.
- [What to do if you clicked a scam link](https://alphaengineerai.com/what-to-do-if-you-clicked-a-scam-link.html): calm response checklist after a click.
- [Qué hacer si hiciste clic en un enlace de estafa](https://alphaengineerai.com/que-hacer-si-hiciste-clic-en-un-enlace-de-estafa.html): lista tranquila en español para proteger cuentas, pagos y dispositivos.
- [O que fazer se clicou num link de golpe](https://alphaengineerai.com/o-que-fazer-se-clicou-num-link-de-golpe.html): lista calma em português para proteger contas, pagamentos e dispositivos.
- [How to tell if a text is a scam](https://alphaengineerai.com/how-to-tell-if-a-text-is-a-scam.html): pause-and-verify checklist.
- [Privacy and safety](https://alphaengineerai.com/privacy-and-safety.html): what not to paste into a checker and how to use it responsibly.
- [How to report an online scam](https://alphaengineerai.com/report-online-scam.html): official reporting routes across 19 countries and regions, plus guidance for others.

## Safe interpretation

Never provide passwords, payment details, verification codes, identity documents, or private addresses to a public checker. Redact a message before review. A suspicious-looking message should be verified through the official app, website, or a known contact route.
